fusions.name: Doubt Made Heavy
fusions.desc: Slams your full weight down, dealing 30 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles. Against a boss or an elite it also deals 5% of their maximum health. Its damage rises 6% for every 10% of your health already gone (max 30%).

fusions.name: Dead Weight
fusions.desc: A tail slam that deals 5 damage and leaves the target 6% easier to wound for 3 seconds, with a 20% chance to leave it [Pinned] for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Denned Ball
fusions.desc: You curl into a ball for 3 seconds: blows that reach you deal no damage and no condition can take hold of you. You regain 15 health as you curl.

fusions.name: Larded Hide
fusions.desc: Your maximum health rises by 14, and you have 6% physical resistance.
